title: Demon's Emerald Tools (DET) NO LONGER UPDATING
description: Emerald tools and a bit more, i also added easter eggs (:
body:
# what it does
DET adds multiple new tools and one armour set to the game the tools are insanly powerfull, being able to insta mine most blocks. this kind of power though comes at a mighty price, the crafting recipes include rare items like netherite and totems of undying.

**give a use to your emeralds today and download this mod**
## why you should download this mod
have you ever just had emeralds lying around? change that today and craft them into powerfull weapons  that can slay enemies , destroy blocks like they have no purpose and chop trees forever

# other

So i made a mod about emerald tools and emerald armour with a bit more 
i just wanted to make a fun mod for the people who play minecraft (:
this is my first mod so it won't be great 
oh and i made all the sprites myself 
i will do more updates as quick as i can. i understand it is basic but i am working on it (:
emerald tools are A LOT better than diamond tools but at a big price!
credit to mcreator
https://mcreator.net
this mod adds better tools than netherite but a a price (totems!)
